mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, which metabolize venlafaxine, potentially increasing venlafaxine levels and serotonergic effects; both drugs also carry CNS depression risk.
action: Monitor for increased venlafaxine side effects (dizziness, sedation, serotonin syndrome symptoms); consider venlafaxine dose reduction if needed; counsel on alcohol avoidance regardless of interaction.
